summary: The Bun.WebView driver typed only into a node that held a `value`, but `@pkgs/ui` TextInput puts its test id on the wrapper `<div>`, so `input` / `clear` / `text` on every TextInput were silent no-ops in a real browser (the Solid DOM driver resolved the nested field). Fixed by resolving the wrapper's `<input>` / `<textarea>` like the Solid DOM driver.
